title: Passing env values to a reusable workflow fails with "Unrecognized named-value: 'env'"
symptoms: Unrecognized named-value: 'env'. Located at position 1 within expression: env.IMAGE_TAG
The workflow file is rejected before any job runs
The same expression works inside a normal step
cause: The env context is not available in jobs.ID.with for a uses: call, which only allows github, needs, strategy, matrix, inputs, and vars. Workflow level env also does not flow into the called workflow.
fix: Compute the value in an earlier job and pass it through needs outputs, or store constants in repository variables and use vars.
apply:
jobs:
  prep:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.t.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - id: t
        run: echo "tag=${GITHUB_SHA::7}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  deploy:
    needs: prep
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml
    with:
      image_tag: ${{ needs.prep.outputs.tag }}
affected: GitHub Actions reusable workflows, by design as of October 2026
